summary.name: SRE Prodcast
summary.one_liner: Google's podcast about Site Reliability Engineering and production software, with episodes on SRE fundamentals, career paths, and real Google and industry systems.
use_cases: Learning SRE practices such as postmortems and alerting
Hearing how Google SREs approach incident response
Exploring SRE career paths and advice
Following trends in AI and SRE
Understanding how systems like Maglev and Google Public DNS were built and run
summary.what_it_does: The page lists episodes of Google's SRE podcast across six seasons. Season 1 covers SRE Book concepts such as postmortems, incident management, on-call, automation, SLOs, alerting and monitoring with Google experts. Season 2 focuses on SRE career paths and growth. Later seasons cover system design and history (for example Maglev and Google Public DNS), incident response, observability, platform engineering, and AI's impact on SRE. Each entry gives a short episode description and guest names and roles.
notable: Season 1 walks through concepts from the Google SRE Book with Google experts
Season 2 'Life of an SRE' covers career paths and growth in SRE
Later seasons include episodes on AI in SRE, STPA, data centers, and security
Episodes feature guests from Google, Meta, HashiCorp, Honeycomb and other companies
caveats: Page lists episodes only; it does not state how to listen or where episodes are hosted
Season 6 entry is cut off, so its contents are incomplete on the page
